title: PoolSplit
creator: lestermorgan702 / Darkernity
summary: MIT-licensed Python payout engine, CLI and walletless browser calculator for Tari mining co-ops. It allocates an operator fee and proportional member payouts using integer microTari and the largest-remainder method, then produces a SHA-256 payout manifest. November 19, 2026: the README and announcement describe off-chain computation; the demo holds no keys and makes no chain calls. An Ootle vault/share-table template is a roadmap item, not a deployed component. Review covered the full README, MIT license, submission, Bluesky announcement, repository metadata and public demo text. No releases are listed. Creator-reported tests were not rerun. The recording is a continuous README walkthrough with page scripts and downloads disabled.
cardSummary: Calculate mining co-op payouts by contributed shares and publish a checksum manifest members can independently recompute.
